title: Andhra Pradesh Approves APGenco Plan to Explore Small Modular Nuclear Reactors
summary: The Andhra Pradesh state government approved a proposal by APGenco to evaluate Small Modular Reactor (SMR) nuclear power technology. The initiative envisions setting up SMR power units at retiring thermal power sites or alternative locations.
point1: Andhra Pradesh cleared APGenco to study small modular nuclear reactor deployment.
point2: The initiative targets repurposing retiring thermal power generation sites for nuclear power.

title: India’s Core Sector Growth Surges to 10.9% in October 2026
summary: Growth across India's eight core infrastructure industries expanded to a series-high rate of 10.9% year-on-year in October 2026. Acceleration was primarily driven by strong output in the electricity and coal sectors along with a low base effect.
point1: Infrastructure core sector growth reached a record high of 10.9% in October 2026.
point2: Expansion was spearheaded by sharp output increases in power generation and coal mining.

title: Madhya Pradesh Scraps Two-Child Limit for State Government Employees
summary: The Madhya Pradesh government has repealed the two-child restriction policy for state government staff. The policy change permits state employees with more than two children to retain eligibility for government jobs and promotions.
point1: Madhya Pradesh officially eliminated rule restrictions limiting government employees to two children.
point2: The decision removes administrative penalties regarding employment eligibility and promotions for state personnel.

title: Russia Launches Major Air Strikes on Kyiv Crossings Following Crimean Bridge Attack
summary: Russian forces conducted one of their largest air bombardments targeting river crossings in Kyiv. The offensive followed a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge and coincided with Russia rejecting security guarantees for Ukraine.
point1: Russia executed extensive air strikes against critical transportation crossings in Kyiv.
point2: The attacks followed Ukrainian strikes on the Crimean Bridge earlier in the week.

title: Clinical Trial Shows Pancreatic Cancer Tumors Eliminating in Drug Study
summary: A clinical trial evaluating the oral drug daraxonrasib demonstrated significant tumor shrinkage and complete clearance in select pancreatic cancer patients. The experimental daily pill targets one of the most lethal forms of cancer.
point1: Clinical trial data indicated the daily oral drug daraxonrasib led to tumor disappearance in certain patients.
point2: The treatment targets pancreatic cancer, which has historically carried high mortality rates.

title: Russian Missile Strikes Polish Territory During Allied Military Drills
summary: A Russian missile landed within Poland as allied forces were conducting military exercises in the region. Polish officials reported no injuries or structural damage, but condemned the incident as a provocation by Moscow.
point1: A Russian missile struck Polish territory during an ongoing military exercise with allies.
point2: Polish authorities confirmed no casualties occurred while calling the action a direct provocation.

title: U.S. National Cyber Director Steps Down Amid Widespread Systems Outages
summary: The U.S. National Cyber Director has announced their resignation from office. The departure coincides with a series of unresolved operational outages affecting multiple commercial systems across the United States.
point1: The National Cyber Director of the United States has resigned from office.
point2: The departure comes while multiple nationwide technical outages remain under investigation.

title: Bending Spoons Acquires Mailchimp From Intuit for $3.68 Billion
summary: Tech company Bending Spoons has reached an agreement to acquire marketing platform Mailchimp for $3.68 billion. Intuit had previously purchased Mailchimp in 2021 for approximately $12 billion.
point1: Bending Spoons agreed to buy Mailchimp for a transaction value of $3.68 billion.
point2: Intuit originally acquired the marketing platform in 2021 for roughly $12 billion.

title: UK and EU Finalize Youth Mobility Agreement Ahead of Summit
summary: Negotiators for the United Kingdom and the European Union reached consensus on a bilateral youth mobility framework. The policy is scheduled for formal endorsement at the upcoming UK-EU summit alongside discussions on agricultural trade and carbon regulations.
point1: British and European negotiators drafted a youth mobility framework for bilateral adoption.
point2: The deal signals closer post-Brexit cooperation on cross-border travel, employment, and agricultural standards.
point3: Formal approval is scheduled for the UK-EU summit on Friday.

title: NCB and U.S. DEA Dismantle Transnational Prescription Drug Network
summary: India's Narcotics Control Bureau partnered with the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration in a joint enforcement action titled Operation Monsoon Thunder. Authorities arrested six individuals operating a supply network shipping illicit opioids and controlled pharmaceutical drugs from India to U.S. buyers.
point1: Indian and American narcotics agencies conducted a coordinated crackdown on international illegal drug shipments.
point2: Law enforcement arrested six suspects linked to the unauthorized export of prescription opioids to the United States.
point3: Legal proceedings against the detained suspects are underway in India.

title: Google Updates Gemini to Control Desktop Workflows on macOS
summary: Google released a major update to its Gemini AI platform, introducing autonomous computer-use capabilities for Mac computers. The agent can operate desktop software directly, perform file management, fill forms, and complete multi-step software tasks.
point1: Gemini's desktop software expansion allows direct operating system interaction on Mac devices.
point2: The release reflects growing competition among tech giants to deploy functional AI agents capable of executing complex user tasks.
point3: The capability was deployed in Google's latest software release.

title: Cyclone Akvan Makes Landfall Along Odisha Coast with 80 km/h Winds
summary: Severe weather system Cyclone Akvan crossed the Odisha coastline delivering sustained winds between 70 and 80 km/h. State officials confirmed that disaster management operations prevented major loss of life or destruction to critical municipal infrastructure.
point1: Cyclone Akvan struck the eastern coast of Odisha carrying peak wind speeds of 80 km/h.
point2: Odisha Chief Secretary Anu Garg confirmed no severe casualties or unexpected casualties occurred during landfall.
point3: Weather monitoring agencies and state teams remain deployed across affected districts.

title: Removal proceedings against me infructuous after resignation: Justice Varma tells Lok Sabha Secretariat
summary: Former judge Justice Varma has written to the Lok Sabha Secretariat asserting that parliamentary removal proceedings against him are legally void following his resignation. Parliament had initiated impeachment motions prior to his exit.
point1: Justice Varma formally notified Parliament that removal motions against him lapsed upon his resignation.
point2: Clarifies constitutional procedures governing judicial impeachment proceedings in India.

title: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
summary: California state authorities have opened an investigation into Nvidia focused on its AI hardware business and transfers related to China. The legal inquiry follows the departure of former chief executive Jensen Huang.
point1: California launched an official inquiry into Nvidia regarding its AI chip operations related to China.
point2: Escalates legal and regulatory pressures on the leading U.S. chip producer.

title: Elon Musk says SpaceX has a plan to eliminate cell phone dead zones
summary: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that the firm has completed the design for a miniature rooftop cellular receiver. The product aims to connect directly with satellites to eradicate mobile coverage dead zones globally.
point1: SpaceX finalized hardware design for a compact rooftop terminal to expand satellite direct-to-cell coverage.
point2: Could expand global telecommunications reach and improve disaster connectivity in remote regions.

title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
summary: European leaders gathered at a summit in Berlin announced a unified framework for potential diplomatic negotiations with Russia. Allies stated they are ready to engage in talks to bring an end to the war in Ukraine.
point1: European allies formed a united negotiating position regarding potential peace talks with Russia.
point2: Marks a significant diplomatic push by European states to end the ongoing conflict.

title: Cyclone ‘Akvan’ updates: Three lakh evacuated, 423 rescue teams deployed as cyclone heads to Odisha
summary: Authorities in eastern India have evacuated more than 300,000 people and deployed 423 rescue teams as severe cyclonic storm Akvan approaches the coast. The storm is forecast to cross between north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha near Gopalpur.
point1: Over 300,000 people have been evacuated ahead of Cyclone Akvan's landfall.
point2: Threatens severe coastal flooding, structural damage, and disruption across Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and West Bengal.
point3: Landfall is projected near Gopalpur by noon on November 20, 2026.

title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Chief Executive Officer of Nvidia following revelations regarding an undisclosed personal relationship. The executive exit comes amid heightened geopolitical tension over AI hardware development.
point1: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned from his position following revelations of an undisclosed affair.
point2: Abrupt leadership change at the dominant AI chip manufacturer impacts global tech supply chains and market confidence.
point3: Interim CEO Colette Kress has stepped in to lead the company.

title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
summary: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic completed its initial public offering on Nasdaq, pricing shares at $83 before opening significantly higher. The launch marks the first public market debut for a pure-play frontier AI laboratory.
point1: Anthropic completed its stock market debut, pricing its IPO at $83 per share and raising over $80 billion in capital.
point2: Serves as a critical financial milestone and valuation benchmark for the global AI sector.
point3: Public trading began on Nasdaq under ticker ANT on November 19, 2026.

title: EPFO relaxes withdrawal norms; lowers minimum balance requirement to 10%
summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation eased withdrawal regulations for its members, reducing the required minimum balance to 10%. The Central Board of Trustees also approved a Systematic Withdrawal Plan to provide predictable monthly post-retirement payouts.
point1: EPFO reduced the mandatory minimum account balance to 10% and introduced a Systematic Withdrawal Plan.
point2: The changes offer greater withdrawal flexibility and structured monthly payouts for Indian workers upon retirement.

title: PM Modi pulls up industry leaders over static wages, employment, manufacturing standards
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticized Indian business leaders at the FICCI Annual General Meeting over stagnant wages, job creation, and manufacturing quality. He urged corporate leaders to pass government tax benefits on to the public.
point1: PM Narendra Modi addressed business executives at the FICCI AGM regarding static wages and job creation.
point2: Modi called on domestic industry leaders to pass tax relief benefits down to consumers.

title: Supreme Court upholds tribal land rights, quashes mining-linked acquisition in Odisha
summary: The Supreme Court of India set aside a land acquisition process in Sundargarh, Odisha, intended for Dalmia Cement's mining project. The court ruled that prior Gram Sabha consent is mandatory under the 2013 Land Acquisition Act.
point1: India's Supreme Court invalidated land acquisition in Odisha for a major cement mining project.
point2: The ruling re-affirms mandatory Gram Sabha consent requirements for industrial land acquisitions.

title: Putin vows 'far more painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin warned of harsher retaliation against Ukraine following attacks on the Crimean Bridge. Ukrainian forces carried out a combined attack earlier in the week that inflicted major damage on the structure.
point1: Vladimir Putin threatened escalated strikes in response to Ukrainian damage on the Crimean Bridge.
point2: The Crimean Bridge remains a critical strategic transport link for Russian forces.

title: US consortium wins huge Kenya mining deal, beating Chinese rivals
summary: A United States consortium secured a mining contract in Kenya for the Mrima Hill site, outbidding competing Chinese companies. The site holds critical mineral deposits estimated to be worth more than $60 billion.
point1: A U.S. consortium won the mining contract for Kenya's Mrima Hill critical minerals site.
point2: The site contains an estimated $60 billion in critical mineral deposits strategic to global industry.

title: Venezuela signs military deal with US less than a year after Maduro's removal
summary: Venezuela signed a formal military agreement with the United States less than a year after the removal of Nicolas Maduro. The U.S. Secretary of Defense stated that Venezuela has transitioned into a security partner.
point1: Venezuela entered into a strategic military agreement with the United States.
point2: The pact follows the political transition after former President Nicolas Maduro's removal.

title: UK government forced to disclose secret Apple backdoor order
summary: A UK legal tribunal ordered the government to reveal details of a secret backdoor demand issued to Apple. The tribunal rejected national security arguments presented by London officials attempting to withhold the information.
point1: A UK tribunal ruled that the British government must disclose a secret order issued to Apple.
point2: The court rejected claims that releasing details of the demand would harm national security.

title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
summary: Reports indicate that Meta's AI agent Muse has cross-contaminated user conversations and surfaced private information to employees. Exposed details included childcare requests, career advice, product orders, and personal bank account balances.
point1: Meta's AI agent Muse reportedly displayed private messages and financial data to unintended users.
point2: The privacy lapse highlights operational and safety concerns regarding internal AI agent deployments.

title: Odisha gears up for cyclone Akvan, shifts 3 lakh people to safety
summary: Authorities in Odisha evacuated approximately 300,000 people to safe locations in preparation for severe cyclonic storm Akvan. The India Meteorological Department forecasts the storm will make landfall near Gopalpur by noon on November 20.
point1: Odisha authorities moved 300,000 residents to safety ahead of severe cyclonic storm Akvan.
point2: The storm is projected to cross the coast with sustained winds of 90-100 kmph and gusts reaching 110 kmph.
point3: Landfall near Gopalpur is expected by noon on November 20, 2026.

title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic began trading on Nasdaq at $111 per share, opening 33% above its initial public offering price of $83. The public offering raised more than $80 billion in new capital.
point1: Anthropic shares began trading at $111 on Nasdaq after pricing its IPO at $83 per share.
point2: The public listing generated more than $80 billion in capital for the company.

title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
summary: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority. The verdict stems from a 2017 military crackdown in the country that killed thousands of people.
point1: The UN's top court found Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya minority.
point2: The unprecedented ruling addresses the military crackdown launched in 2017.

title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping issued a joint peace declaration following a meeting in China. The talks marked the first time all three leaders engaged in a trilateral discussion.
point1: Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping released a joint peace declaration following trilateral talks.
point2: The summit represents the first trilateral meeting held between the leaders of the three world powers.

title: India Inks Agreement with Israel to Upgrade Barak Missile System
summary: The Indian government signed a defense contract with Israel to upgrade the Barak missile system utilized by Indian armed forces. The program focuses on modernizing existing defense capabilities.
point1: India finalized a deal with Israel to modernize its Barak missile system.
point2: The upgrades are designed to enhance national air defense assets.

title: Cyclone Akvan Intensifies into Severe Storm Threatening Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
summary: Cyclone Akvan has strengthened into a severe cyclonic storm in the Bay of Bengal, prompting disaster alerts across eastern India. State authorities in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha are preparing for expected landfall between Machilipatnam and Puri.
point1: Cyclone Akvan intensified as it moved across the Bay of Bengal toward coastal India.
point2: Disaster management departments in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha issued alerts and mobilized response units.
point3: Landfall is expected along the east coast between Machilipatnam and Puri.

title: Israeli Military Conducts Ground Operation Beyond Gaza's Yellow Line
summary: Israeli forces launched a ground operation past the designated Yellow Line in Gaza, stating the movement was necessary to dismantle an underground tunnel. Hamas denounced the operation as a major violation of the active ceasefire agreement.
point1: Israeli troops crossed the Yellow Line inside Gaza for a targeted operation against underground infrastructure.
point2: Hamas condemned the move as a flagrant breach of ceasefire terms.

title: UN Court Prepares Historic Verdict in Myanmar Rohingya Genocide Case
summary: The International Court of Justice is preparing to issue a judgment in the genocide case against Myanmar regarding atrocities committed against Rohingya Muslims. No nation state has previously been found guilty of committing genocide by an international tribunal.
point1: The UN International Court of Justice is delivering its verdict on genocide allegations against Myanmar.
point2: A guilty ruling would mark a historic international legal precedent regarding state responsibility for genocide.

title: Anthropic Prices IPO at $83 per Share, Valuing Company at $1.5 Trillion
summary: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic has reportedly priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, above its expected range. The debut values the creator of the Claude AI model at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.
point1: Anthropic set its IPO pricing at $83 per share, exceeding previous estimates.
point2: The valuation positions Anthropic among the highest-valued public debuts in technology history.

title: United States Officially Loses Measles Elimination Status
summary: The United States has officially lost its status as a country that has eliminated measles due to persistent domestic outbreaks. Health experts warn that reversing the disease's spread and recovering elimination status will take years of public health efforts.
point1: The U.S. lost its official measles-free status due to widespread ongoing transmission.
point2: Public health officials report it will take years to regain elimination standing.

title: Voyager 1 Reaches Historic One Light-Day Distance From Earth
summary: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft has reached a distance of one light-day from Earth, becoming the first man-made object to reach this milestone. Launched in 1977, the deep-space probe continues to transmit telemetry data back to ground controllers.
point1: Voyager 1 is now one light-day away from Earth, a landmark distance for human spaceflight.
point2: The 49-year-old probe remains functional and continues sending scientific data.

title: India’s October Crude Import Bill Soars 87.5% to $19.5 Billion
summary: India's crude oil import bill rose 87.5% to $19.5 billion in October as geopolitical conflicts in West Asia pushed global energy prices higher. Total import volumes increased by 11% over the same month.
point1: India's monthly crude import expenditure increased 87.5% to $19.5 billion in October.
point2: Crude import volumes grew by 11% alongside rising global energy prices.

title: Bombay High Court Quashes ICICI Bank's Sanction Against Ex-CEO Chanda Kochhar
summary: The Bombay High Court set aside ICICI Bank's sanction order allowing prosecution of former CEO Chanda Kochhar in a loan fraud investigation. The court held that only the Reserve Bank of India holds statutory authority under Section 36-AA(1) of the Banking Regulation Act to grant such permissions.
point1: Bombay High Court invalidated the ICICI Bank board's prosecution sanction against Chanda Kochhar.
point2: The court ruled that only the RBI possesses legal authority to grant prosecution permission under banking law.

title: ACME Finalizes $3.6 Billion Deal for Green Ammonia Plant in Odisha
summary: ACME Group has secured a $3.6 billion deal to construct a green ammonia manufacturing facility in Odisha. The project is designed with an annual capacity of 760,000 tonnes to support clean energy transitions.
point1: ACME signed a $3.6 billion agreement to build a green ammonia plant in Odisha.
point2: The plant is engineered to produce 760,000 tonnes of green ammonia per year.
point3: The facility is expected to be commissioned by 2029.

title: India Imposes 162.5% Tariff on Bulk Scotch Imports Amid UK Trade Dispute
summary: India has imposed a 162.5% combined duty and tax rate on bulk Scotch imports amid a customs classification dispute with the UK. Over 80 containers belonging to major liquor companies including Diageo, Pernod Ricard, and Bacardi are currently stuck at Indian ports.
point1: India raised total duties and taxes on bulk Scotch imports to 162.5%.
point2: More than 80 import containers from Bacardi, Diageo, and Pernod Ricard remain held at ports.

title: Nvidia Outlines Conditions for Financing Neocloud Data Centers
summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress clarified the company's policy on backstopping data center loans for neocloud providers. Nvidia will only take on loan obligations if a neocloud secures independent financing and builds the facility with Nvidia hardware installed.
point1: Nvidia will limit loan guarantees to completed neocloud facilities containing installed Nvidia hardware.
point2: The policy clarifies Nvidia's exposure to debt guarantees in expanding AI cloud infrastructure.

title: Nvidia Board Reaffirms It Will Not Reinstate Ousted CEO Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia's board of directors stated that it has no plans to bring back former CEO Jensen Huang following his resignation. The decision comes despite calls for his return, while interim CEO Colette Kress continues to direct company operations.
point1: Nvidia's board formally announced it has no intention to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.
point2: Huang offered to return to the company after resigning last week amid personal controversies.

title: House Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House
summary: House Democrats selected Representative Hakeem Jeffries as their candidate for Speaker of the House. The nomination puts Jeffries on track to become the first Black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control in January.
point1: House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries to serve as Speaker of the House.
point2: Jeffries would become the first Black lawmaker to serve as House Speaker in U.S. history.
point3: Democrats will formally take control of the House of Representatives in January.

title: Kuwait and Bahrain Repel Iranian Strikes Following U.S. Raid in Gulf
summary: Kuwait reported repelling an Iranian military attack, its first in two months, following a U.S. air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm. Bahrain also reported being targeted by Iranian strikes amid escalating conflict in the region.
point1: Kuwait and Bahrain repelled Iranian attacks triggered by a U.S. military strike on Qeshm island.
point2: The engagement represents Kuwait's first reported Iranian attack in two months.

title: Trump, Putin, and Xi Meet in China Ahead of High-Stakes Summit
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump met Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China ahead of historic talks. The three world leaders are scheduled to hold a joint meeting on Thursday during the summit.
point1: Trump, Putin, and Xi met in China prior to their official trilateral meeting.
point2: This marks the first time all three world leaders are holding a joint meeting together.
point3: The three-way summit is scheduled to take place on Thursday.
